بَهْلَلَةٌ بهلله بهللة هلل هللة The quality of shrinking from foul things, and of generosity, or nobleness. (JK.)
بُهْلُولٌ بهلول One that shrinks from foul things, and is generous, or noble; applied to a man (Ibn- 'Abbád, JK) and to a woman: (JK:) pl. بَهَالِيلُ. (Ibn-'Abbád, JK.) A lord, chief, or prince, combining all good qualities. (Seer, K.) ― -b2- A great, or frequent, laugher. (S, K.)
